The Incredible Dr. Pol: Compilation T14 - Ep. 5

On this special episode of “The Incredible Dr. Pol,” Michigan’s most trusted vets are always on call, because animal emergencies don’t wait for business hours. From a cat attacked by a raccoon to a pig struggling with farrowing, the team tackles a wide range of urgent cases — Dr. Pol even heeds the call for a dangerously distressed horse and saves a Chihuahua’s vision after a scuffle.
The Incredible Dr. Pol T23 - Ep. 8

Surprises come in all scrapes and sizes. A cockatiel has a tweaked beak and Dr. Lisa ponders a barn cats bladder leak. When a Chihuahua arrives after hours with an eye emergency, Doc remains focused. A serious blemish surfaces on a show dog and a hoarse horse struggles to breathe. Everyone comes together to make Dianes birthday extra special.
The Incredible Dr. Pol T23 - Ep. 2

Dr. Pol treats three bovines and one tiny rabbit before heading to the Netherlands with Diane to celebrate his 80th birthday. Just because the Docs away, it doesnt mean that the clinic slows down. A very vocal pig needs surgery to treat a hernia, a blocked cat is in pain and requires immediate relief, and a puppy is feeling the effects of eating something inedible. .
Crocodiles Of The Okavango - Ep. 1

In Botswana’s Okavango Delta, a young Nile crocodile embarks on her first season of motherhood. After winning the chance to breed, she faces fierce competition for nesting territory and the challenge of safeguarding her eggs through months of flooding, searing heat and relentless predators. Monitor lizards, mongooses, baboons and rival crocodiles all threaten her nest while she stands guard.
Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara - Ep. 1

Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In “Croc Wars,” follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal.
Planet Of The Reptiles - Ep. 1
Reptiles are like scaly monsters from another time. As scientists unlock their secrets, the more remarkable they become.
Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor - Ep. 1

In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called 'boss crocs,” are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction.
Day Of The Dragon - Ep. 1

The clock starts just before sunrise - when the temperature begins to rise. It’s hard work being the world’s biggest lizard on Rinca island. Competition is so fierce he can’t afford to slow down. For the biggest male on the island, an ever- warming environment and shrinking hunting grounds threaten his survival across every hour of the day.

Killer Safari T1 - Ep. 2

Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

Prairie Dog Manor T1 - Ep. 9
It's monsoon season in Dogtown. Scarlett and her family hurry to reinforce their burrow before the flooding begins, but deal with unexpected guests right before the storm arrives.
Prairie Dog Manor T1 - Ep. 10

Property disputes are settled a little differently in Dogtown. In search of first burrows on their own, Pelt and Digit come up against some unexpected challenges from Badgers and Alpha dogs protecting their territory.

Nicobar Islands: A Monkey's Long Tale - Ep. 1

The Nicobar Islands were significantly impacted by the massive tsunami of 2004. This documentary is a compelling exploration of nature's ability to adapt to millions of years of gradual tectonic change and a sudden natural disaster, and a journey into a world few people are fortunate enough to see.
Africa's Hidden Wonders T1 - Ep. 1

Blanketed by mists and bordered by dense jungles filled with rampaging beasts, Rwanda is a country cloaked in mystery. This tropical land of fire and forest lies at the crest of the mountainous backbone of Africa. Home to the African great apes and some of the continent's most mysterious landscapes - from the Virunga volcanoes, to rich rainforest to exploding lakes.
Africa's Hidden Wonders T1 - Ep. 2

Ethiopia is a wilderness of extremes - from lush lakes to towering peaks - where life has had to adapt in order to survive. This ancient land has cradled life since the dawn of time, and beyond the scorched deserts lie fortified mountains that conceal natural treasure troves of wildlife found nowhere else on Earth.

Everything feels connected as the vets see patterns emerge in their cases. The Incredible Dr. Pol T24 - Ep. 1

A major storm blows into Central Michigan, and as the snow piles up, so do the cases! While clients brave the weather to get care for their animals, Dr. Pol and Charles battle thundersnow when responding to an emergency farm call. Dr. Lisa needs ten stitches to repair a horses deep cut, and Dr. Brenda treats a Rottweilers very swollen face. .
Heartland Docs, DVM: Goat Surprise! Compilation - Ep. 1

Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder never know what is going to hop or walk into their clinic. No matter the case, they are always prepared for the most unexpected patients. The Schroeders care for all animals, no matter the challenge, including a rabbit that has lost its hop and duck with a weird waddle.
Heartland Docs, DVM T3 - Ep. 1
